Incident Bot: :rotating_light: Pager — High GPU pressure detected in us-west-2 (multi-zone hotspot). inference-pool-usw2-hot and thin-prov are reporting sustained 90%+ GPU utilization and autoscaler churn. Some requests are hitting fallback routes. Auto-heal attempts failing due to repeated preemptions. Incident ID: INC-1912345670. Link: https://internal.ops/inc/INC-1912345670

Alex Chen: I'm on call and looking now. Does this coincide with the new quantized-2 deploy?

Maya Patel: yes, deploy rolled ~10m before alert. seeing a surge in sequence length for a subset of customers that spikes KV cache usage.

Alex Chen: ok, initial mitigation plan: 1) pause quantized-2 deploy in region, 2) add temporary headroom to pools, 3) route low-priority traffic to fallback models.

Maya Patel: pausing canary now.

Ops Bot: action — canary deployment rollbacks: quantized-2 -> paused (region: us-west-2). Triggered by @Maya Patel.

David Ortiz: starting manual scale of inference-pool-usw2-hot to +4 GPUs to create breathing room.

Maya Patel: run this please (kubectl snippet):
```
# scale node pool (GKE example)
kubectl -n infra scale deployment gpu-pool-usw2-hot --replicas=6
# bump autoscaler target headroom (temp)
kubectl apply -f - <<EOF
apiVersion: config.redwood/v1
kind: AutoscalerProfile
metadata:
  name: gpu-headroom-temp
spec:
  region: us-west-2
  targetHeadroomPct: 20
EOF
```

David Ortiz: applied scale and headroom. Confirmed new nodes provisioning.

Ops Bot: Notice: manual scale applied. New replicas: 6. Estimated provisioning time: ~3m.

Emily Zhao: customer-impact check: initial logs show increased 5xxs and timeouts for a small subset of enterprise customers (approx 2% of requests in us-west-2) between 12:41–12:58. Downstream retries caused higher tail latencies for others. No persisted data loss.

Alex Chen: can we get list of affected customer IDs for outreach?

Emily Zhao: pulling now, will DM legal + CS for coordinated outreach. Preliminary list attached to INC-1912345670 ticket.

David Ortiz: logs snippet showing preemptions + OOMs: 
```
[2026-03-15T12:45:02Z] gpu-0 preempted by host-scheduler
[2026-03-15T12:45:03Z] infer-worker-71 OOM when allocating KVcache 1.2GB -> killed
[2026-03-15T12:46:10Z] autoscaler: scale down triggered for short window -> leads to churn
```

Maya Patel: root cause hypothesis: simultaneous canary + longer context requests + preemption policy edge case causing autoscaler to mis-evaluate utilization (scale down mid-surge).

Samir Rao: good triage. Next steps: short-term remediation done (canary paused, +4 GPUs, temp headroom). Need postmortem and 3 concrete remediation items with owners and deadlines. I'll own coordinating.

Samir Rao: scheduling postmortem: propose 24h retrospective meeting today at 17:00 PT. Who's available?

Alex Chen: can do.

Maya Patel: yes.

Emily Zhao: yes, will bring customer impact notes.

Samir Rao: action items (assigning now):
- A1: Autoscaler policy audit & fix (owner: Maya Patel) — ensure scale-down cooldown respects recent preemption events. target due: 2026-03-19
- A2: Deploy safety: block canary if average seq_len > threshold and KV cache pressure high (owner: Alex Chen) — target due: 2026-03-17
- A3: Customer outreach + incident summary (owner: Emily Zhao) — initial outreach by 2026-03-16, full postmortem note by 2026-03-20
- A4: Capacity buffer: evaluate permanent +10% headroom policy for critical regions (owner: David Ortiz) — due: 2026-03-22

Maya Patel: ack A1. Will start a PR with tests for scale-down cooldown logic.

Alex Chen: ack A2. I'll add canary gating to deploy pipeline and add metric gate for avg_seq_len and kv_pressure.

Emily Zhao: ack A3. drafting customer note now.

David Ortiz: ack A4. will run simulation and cost delta by EOW.

Ops Bot: FYI — temporary headroom policy will auto-revert in 6 hours unless extended.

Samir Rao: let's also add a monitoring alert to detect autoscaler oscillation early (new alert: autoscaler-churn-rate > 3 in 10m). Maya, Alex, can you add that to dashboards?

Maya Patel: adding alert to infra-dashboard now.

Alex Chen: added a quick Grafana panel and alert rule: autoscaler_churn_rate{region="us-west-2"} > 3 for 10m.

Incident Bot: Update: GPU utilization returning to normal after scale. No further 5xx spikes in the last 4m.

Emily Zhao: customer outreach initial messages sent to affected contacts (CS ticket numbers: CS-8842, CS-8843). Notified Legal for review.

Samir Rao: good. Postmortem meeting confirmed 17:00 PT. I'll put owners in the calendar invite and attach the incident timeline.

Alex Chen: will follow up with PR links during postmortem.

Maya Patel: I'll post a short remediation checklist in the postmortem doc: rollback gating, autoscaler cooldown fix, KV cache soft-limits.

David Ortiz: removing temporary +4 manual scale on completion; leaving autoscaler headroom at +20% until postmortem decision.

Ops Bot: Manual scale rollback initiated by @David Ortiz. New replicas: 2 (autoscaler-managed).

Alex Chen: quick note — consider adding a preemption-aware metric to autoscaler scoring so we don't count ephemeral spikes.

Samir Rao: noted. Final items: Emily to close customer comms after postmortem, Maya and Alex to submit PRs, David to validate long-term capacity plan. We'll track A1–A4 in the remediation board and close when validated by SRE.

Emily Zhao: thanks everyone. Great coordination. :white_check_mark:

Alex Chen: thanks — following up in the postmortem doc.

Incident Bot: Incident INC-1912345670 status: mitigated. Postmortem scheduled.
